description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write/MultiEdit on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop. Tracked on purpose — the skill it dispatches to is committed under .claude/skills/impeccable/, so the hook has to ship with it or the tree is 65k lines that only fire on the machine that installed them. The .github/ copy has the same wiring in .github/hooks/impeccable.json for Copilot. Both commands are guarded: a checkout missing the skill is a clean no-op, not an error.
